companyName.title: Company name
companyName.description: Label above the company spaces in the Stackboard sidebar.

spaces.title: Company spaces
spaces.description: Read-only spaces shown first on every new tab, each with stacks of links.

onboarding.title: Start here space
onboarding.description: Opens first and carries a Start here badge for a person's first 30 days, then moves after the other company spaces.

announcement.title: Announcement
announcement.description: One line across the top of every new tab.

id.title: Announcement id (change it to show a dismissed line again)

showManagedBookmarks.title: Show the ManagedBookmarks policy folder as a space

goLinks.title: Go links
goLinks.description: Short names people type after go and a space in the address bar, each with the address it opens (http or https). Names use letters, numbers, dots, dashes, underscores and slashes.

brand.title: Brand
brand.description: The company's name in the sidebar header and its accent colour, for everyone.

lock.title: Locked settings
lock.description: Settings Stackboard hides, with a line saying the company manages them.

importExport.title: Hide copying bookmarks in, backups and snapshot downloads

pro.title: Hide Stackboard Pro: no prices, trial or upgrade prompts

ai.title: Turn off AI tidy and AI pick

rating.title: Never ask people to rate Stackboard
